parameters: I met a traveler from an antique land,
Who said: "Two vast and hollow coins of gold
Lie in the cave. Near them, on the stone,
Half-sunk, a broken ledger lies alone.
Its pages bear a mocking, bitter sneer,
And tell the tale of one who hoarded fear,
Whose lust for gold, and hunger for more gain,
Outlasted all, and brought only pain.
And on the pedestal these words appear:
'My name is Greg, merchant of all things,
Look on my works, ye mighty, and despair!'
Nothing beside remains. Round the decay
Of that colossal wreck, boundless and bare
The lone and level caves stretch far away.
None of us shall regale his tale.
Wanna take a look at my wares?
Thank you for you patronage. Nya~~~
